_about: Native looks for NLP Studio, measured from the Negative Lab Pro v2.3 enhanced looks (fitted, not copied): per look, encoded-MelissaRGB grey curves at value 0, 0.1 ... 1 per channel, and a hue/saturation/value map of [hue shift deg, saturation scale, value shift] at 24 hues x 5 saturations x 8 values (evenly spaced); saturation levels 1..10 scale chroma relative to level 5.
